confidence_notes: Food anchors use Lugano cost-of-living averages updated 18 November 2026 as a close proxy for July. Cocktail uses local price guidance; wine is estimated relative to draft beer. Accommodation is a holistic July summer estimate and has the greatest uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Lugano city prices; accommodation is modeled from Swiss lakeside tourist-market and hotel norms.
